rows.title: Dirty Dancing 1987, directed by Emile Ardolino | Film review
rows.comment: Gyrating hips and intense eye contact do fill up much of the running time
rows.verdict_le10: Gyrating hips and intense eye contact do fill up much of the running time
rows.dek_lead: Gyrating hips and intense eye contact do fill up much of the running time, but there’s more to this movie than love on the dancefloor. The summer changes Baby, and tests her theories about the world. It’s about standing up for what’s right
